## Description
Briefly describe the change and the rationale behind it.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance or refactoring improvement

## Testing Done
Describe the tests you ran to verify your changes:
- [ ] Ran `npm run typecheck` without errors
- [ ] Ran `npm run build` cleanly
- [ ] Tested in local browser (`http://localhost:5173/` or Docker `http://localhost/`)
- [ ] Tested multi-board switching / persistence
- [ ] Tested SVG/Mermaid import (if touching parser code)
- [ ] Tested E2EE collaboration (if touching WebSocket/crypto code)

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style and guidelines of this project
